description.en: One-step local model onboarding plus a light harness for DSH. On load it probes loopback and private-network inference endpoints (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio), reads each model's context window and output budget from the backend, and registers the provider through settings, so a local model becomes selectable without hand-writing config. It then trims only that provider: masks the tool list through tools.restrict, drops named system-prompt sections and memory contexts, swaps the injected instruction block for a short one while preserving its first 80 and last 96 characters, and truncates tool-schema descriptions without touching structure or required fields. Cloud providers are returned as the same assembly object, untouched. The injected block is re-read from disk on every assembly, so editing the file takes effect on the next request with no reload. The panel in the plugin detail page is a live operations view: it shows whether the takeover is active and by which hook, how many characters the last assembly was trimmed from and to, and which providers are online (probed concurrently, with a real one-shot completion reporting latency and reply text per provider). If a local backend is not running, the panel offers a one-click launch: it probes the port first (never starting a duplicate), then starts the matching server (ollama serve, or a custom command you supply) detached and polls until the endpoint answers, clamping the wait to 3-600 seconds, reaping the child it just spawned if it never answers, and naming the paths it searched when it cannot find the binary. A stop button kills backends this plugin started (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL) and refuses to touch a server somebody else launched. When a model has just been downloaded and no backend exists yet, the panel can also scan the machine for .gguf files with hard caps (300 models, 20000 directory entries, Downloads only one level deep), start llama-server on the chosen one (skipping the .mmproj. vision projection and reusing a server that already answers), register the provider under the model id the backend reports, and run one real completion to prove it works. Before spawning anything it does a fit check that counts only the part of the file the GPU cannot hold: hostBytes = fileSize - VRAM, compared against max(total RAM - 2GB, free RAM). A file far larger than RAM is refused outright; a heavy host-side remainder is refused unless you confirm; the same remainder under mmap is only a warning, because the weights land in reclaimable page cache. A load-mode selector (auto / mmap / none / mlock / mmap+mlock) maps to llama.cpp --load-mode, and the default is whatever the engine picks. From 0.4.2 everything above is derived from the platform instead of assumed: home and data directories come from os.homedir() and the OS conventions (LOCALAPPDATA on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support on macOS, XDG_DATA_HOME elsewhere); backend binaries are looked up in the official install locations of each OS and can be pinned with OLLAMA_BIN, LLAMA_SERVER_BIN, VLLM_BIN or LMSTUDIO_BIN; model discovery walks DSH_LOCAL_MODELS_DIR, ~/models, ~/llama.cpp/models, ~/.cache/llama.cpp and the LM Studio data directory, with the WorkBuddy layout demoted to one candidate among them. VRAM is asked from nvidia-smi, then rocm-smi, then sysctl hw.memsize on Apple Silicon (flagged unified, so the same bytes are not charged twice), and any flip to a unified-memory budget is handled explicitly. Before building a command line the plugin runs llama-server --help once and keeps only the flags that build actually has, so older engines get --n-gpu-layers 99 and no KV quantization while newer ones get auto plus q8_0; anything it cannot probe is passed through rather than dropped. LM Studio is started with lms server start --port N rather than being lumped in with the engines that need a model argument, and vLLM gets its own --model example instead of llama.cpp syntax. Windows, macOS and Linux are all exercised in CI, including a windows-latest and a macos-latest job, because a cross-platform claim that has only ever run on one OS is not a claim. Two of those suites exist specifically to catch this machine's blind spots: one replays the whole suite with process.platform rewritten to each OS, and one deletes every advantage this development box has — no nvidia-smi, no rocm-smi, no sysctl, an empty PATH, a home directory with no models — and requires graceful degradation rather than a crash. That last one caught a real class of bug: several assertions hardcoded 'lms.exe', which cannot pass where the executable has no suffix. Measured on the reference machine: a 16.9GB 27.2B MoE with 14.5GB of VRAM holds a 285-691MB working set and sustains 76 tok/s after a 1000-2000 token warm-up, so file size alone is not a fit signal. From 0.4.3 the scanned models are shown as a table rather than a dropdown (one row per gguf, with its size and any fit warning), so you can see what is on disk before choosing. From 0.4.4 the delete button on the provider table removes the provider entry, not the weights file on disk. That distinction matters: what people actually want to clear out is the dead entry - one pointing at a port that never answered, one registered twice for the same port, one whose model file was deleted long ago - not a 15.8GB gguf. Deleting a config is undone by importing again; deleting a gguf is not. The removal goes through settings.mutate with an unset op on \['providers', id], because update merges layers: writing null there leaves a null provider key that the loader reads as a broken config rather than an absent entry, and only mutate/unset is implemented as Reflect.deleteProperty. The result is read back afterwards, because unset on a key that comes from a lower layer (the profile cordis.patch.yml or a home patch) does not delete it - it restores the inherited value, so the call succeeds while the entry stays. When the entry is still there the panel says so and points at the file to edit instead of reporting success, and a DSH whose settings service predates mutate() is told plainly rather than silently ignored. Deleting takes two clicks and clearing the confirmation is as easy as clicking another row; on success the online and baseURL caches are cleared and the tool surface is recomputed, since the provider list changed. The gguf itself is never touched by this plugin - the scanned-model table is display and selection only.VRAM reporting is driver-dependent. From 0.4.5 model discovery also reads Ollama's own storage: its blobs are named sha256-… with no extension, so extension matching could never list them. Weights are now accepted by extension OR by GGUF magic header (only dot-free files of at least 8MB, capped at 600 header reads per scan; obviously-not-weights extensions like .json/.md/.safetensors/.part are never opened). Ollama models are resolved from their manifests: the model layer is picked by mediaType application/vnd.ollama.image.model (never adapter/mmproj layers), the human-readable name is restored from the manifest path (…/qwen3/8b becomes qwen3:8b, …/latest stays bare), tags sharing one blob merge into a single row, and the metadata kv supplies name, quantization and context length. Adopting an Ollama model does not start a duplicate llama-server over the same weights: it confirms ollama serve answers on 11434 (launching it if not) and registers the provider under the tag the endpoint itself reports — the blob's sha256 name would never match anything, since 11434 lists qwen3:14b, not sha256-a8cc…. Two real-machine-only traps fixed on the way: existsSync('<file>/') returns true on Windows, so manifest-vs-directory branching now goes by parseable content instead of trailing-slash semantics; and the quantization label table had been copied from a stale ggml enum generation, labelling ggml_type 15 as Q5_K_S while ollama show reports Q4_K_M. Same-blob dedup is by (dev,ino), keeping whichever entry has a name. Verified on the reference machine: the scan goes from 1 row to 4 — qwen3:14b (8.64G) and qwen3:8b (4.87G) now appear with Q4_K_M badges — in 4ms; npm run verify exits 0 (launcher 57, portable 35, panel-host green including the linux/darwin simulated-platform runs); the new panel-host suite builds a real miniature Ollama store in tmpdir and points OLLAMA_MODELS at it, so results no longer depend on whether the test machine happens to have Ollama installed. From 0.4.6 the panel shows each model its real name instead of its file name, because some download tooling stores every weight under one generic file name, leaving the real name only inside the GGUF header. The scan now reads each file GGUF KV section - not a fixed-size head buffer, because tokenizer.ggml.tokens (hundreds of thousands of strings on a large MoE model) and the chat template push general.file_type past any window; and GGUF string arrays are interleaved (u64 length plus payload per element), so treating them as a length table walks the cursor off the rails and produces astronomically large reads. Reading and skipping are accounted separately: key names and types are always read, string values over 256KB and string arrays are only walked past without copying, non-string arrays over 64 elements are skipped outright, and a cursor past the file size stops the read, because an out-of-range position means the cursor is wrong rather than that a limit should be raised. The displayed name goes Ollama tag, then general.basename plus size_label, then general.name, then the file name, with the full string kept for the hover text since it usually carries internal build numbers; mmproj files are now identified by general.type as well as by name. A short read (truncated file) no longer feeds half a value into the parser. On the reference machine, reading one file header parses 44 keys in about 16ms, and a whole scan takes about 31ms. From 0.4.7 the smoke test no longer fails the first time and passes the second. The old code gave both request attempts one shared AbortController and one shared 30-second timer, so the total budget covered both rounds: a cold load of a large model burned it in round one, the abort left the signal permanently aborted, and the second round (the Ollama-style reasoning_effort: none retry) could not even be sent - which is exactly why the first click returned This operation was aborted and the second succeeded. Now each attempt gets its own controller and timer, a timeout retries once automatically (retryOnTimeout, on by default) because a first-request timeout almost always means the weights are still being read from disk, and non-timeout errors (refused connection, HTTP error) are not retried at all. Timeouts report themselves: the message says the wait exceeded smokeTimeout, whether a retry already happened, and points at the new smokeTimeout setting (seconds, default 60, clamped to 5-600) - port responding is not the same as tokens coming out, so it is a separate knob from launchTimeout. Unrelated: an example naming one specific model was dropped from the panel copy, since not every machine has that model downloaded, and the explanation now describes the mechanism instead. From 0.4.8 adopting a plain .gguf no longer registers an unrelated Ollama model. The port field used to follow the last click rather than the file: selecting an Ollama entry moved it to 11434, selecting a plain .gguf did not move it back, so a 11434 left over from an earlier click stayed. The server accepted it as given, probed the port, found Ollama answering and borrowed it (the skipped-launch log line about the port already answering is this path), and then the model id - derived from the file name - could not be matched against Ollama's /v1/models, where the fallback was to grab the first entry in the list. Embedding models tend to sort first, so the adopt registered a model the user never selected. Now the port follows the file: a plain .gguf landing on another engine's port (ollama 11434, vLLM 8000, LM Studio 1234) is moved to 8090 and the panel says so. Only ports belonging to a known engine are overridden - a hand-typed 9999 aimed at your own llama-server is left alone. The model-id fallback no longer guesses either: it takes the only entry when there is exactly one (a single-model backend may legitimately report a different id than the file name) and otherwise reports an error listing the ids it did see, rather than registering a wrong provider. From 0.4.9 the panel can no longer vanish. It used to be possible for the whole section to disappear from the plugin detail page while the host stayed up, the HTTP bridge kept answering, and no crash log appeared. The cause was a scope error: a helper was declared inside one component and referenced from another, which is valid JavaScript and passes a syntax check, so it only threw at render time - when the user pressed the scan button and React ran the state updater. The host wraps every slot entry in an error boundary whose fallback is an empty anchor, so the throw was contained silently: the panel was not uninstalled or crashed, it was replaced by an empty div. The helpers now live in the module scope both components share. The client half also gained its own test - a minimal React stand-in loads the real panel module, really calls the components, really runs the state updater at render time, and presses the scan button, so this class of error can no longer reach a release.
description.zh: 给小本地模型的一步到位接入 + 轻量 harness。装载时自动探测回环与私有网段上的推理端点（llama.cpp、Ollama、vLLM、LM Studio），从后端读出每个模型的窗口与输出预算，再经 settings 注册 provider —— 不用手写配置就能在模型选择器里选到本地模型。随后只对这一个 provider 裁剪：用 tools.restrict 收缩工具面、按段名丢弃系统提示词段落与记忆 context、把注入的指令块换成一页纸同时保留其首 80 与末 96 字符、截断工具 schema 的 description 而不动结构与 required。云端 provider 原样返回同一个 assembly 对象，不做任何改动。注入正文每次装配都重新读盘，改文件下一次请求就生效，不用重载。插件详情页的面板是一块实时运行视图：显示接管是否生效、走的是哪个钩子，最近一次装配的字符进→出与省下的比例，以及各 provider 的在线灯（多路并发点灯，每个本地 provider 还能发一次真实的最小请求，把延迟与回复原文报出来）。本地后端没起来时，面板能一键拉起：先探测端口（已在应答就不重复启动），再按端口拉起对应后端（ollama serve，或你自己填的启动命令），进程独立于宿主存活，随后轮询到端口应答为止，等待上限夹在 3–600 秒，超时会把刚起的那个进程回收掉不留孤儿，找不到可执行文件时会把搜过的路径写清楚。面板上还有停止按钮，只肯停本插件自己起的后端（先 SIGTERM，1.5 秒不退再 SIGKILL），别人的服务一概不动。模型刚下好、后端还不存在时，面板能扫描本机 .gguf（跳过 .mmproj. 视觉投影、按大小降序，并带 300 个模型 / 20000 个目录项 / Downloads 只扫一层这三道上限），选一个就用它拉起 llama-server（端口上已有服务就复用），按后端自报的模型 id 注册 provider，再发一条真实请求证明能用。真正起之前会做一次装得下算账：只算显存装不下的那部分（hostBytes = 文件体积 − 显存），拿它比 max(总内存 − 2GB, 空闲内存)。文件比「显存 + 内存」还大直接拦；落到宿主的内存太多时先不替你起，要你确认；同样的情况若走 mmap 只给警告，因为权重落在可回收的页缓存里。加载方式下拉（auto / mmap / none / mlock / mmap+mlock）对应 llama.cpp 的 --load-mode，默认交给引擎自己决定。0.4.2 起上面每一条都改成按平台推导，而不是假设本机长什么样：家目录与数据目录走 os.homedir() 和各系统惯例（Windows 用 LOCALAPPDATA，macOS 用 ~/Library/Application Support，其它用 XDG_DATA_HOME）；后端二进制按各系统官方安装位置找，也可以用 OLLAMA_BIN / LLAMA_SERVER_BIN / VLLM_BIN / LMSTUDIO_BIN 钉死；找模型依次走 DSH_LOCAL_MODELS_DIR、~/models、~/llama.cpp/models、~/.cache/llama.cpp 与 LM Studio 数据目录，WorkBuddy 的布局降级成其中一个候选。显存先问 nvidia-smi，再问 rocm-smi，Apple Silicon 上问 sysctl hw.memsize 并标成统一内存（同一块字节不重复扣两次）。拼命令行之前会跑一次 llama-server --help，只保留这个 build 真有的参数 —— 老引擎给 --n-gpu-layers 99 且不下发 KV 量化，新引擎给 auto 加 q8_0；探测不出来的参数一律照传，不因为探不到就丢掉。LM Studio 用 lms server start --port N 起，不再和「必须先给模型参数」的引擎混在一起；vLLM 单独给 --model 的示例，不再套 llama.cpp 的写法。Windows、macOS、Linux 三套都在 CI 里跑，另加 windows-latest 与 macos-latest 两个 job —— 只在一个系统上跑过的「跨平台」不算跨平台。其中两套专门用来抓这台开发机的盲区：一套把 process.platform 改掉、整套测试按各系统重跑；另一套把开发机的所有有利条件全删掉（没有 nvidia-smi、没有 rocm-smi、没有 sysctl、PATH 是空的、家目录里没有模型），要求优雅退化而不是崩。后一套抓到过真实的一类 bug：好几处断言写死了 lms.exe，在可执行文件不带后缀的系统上根本不可能过。参考机实测：16.9GB 的 27.2B MoE 配 14.5GB 显存，进程工作集只有 285–691MB，预热 1000–2000 token 后稳定 76 tok/s —— 光看文件大小判断装不装得下是错的。0.4.3 起扫出来的模型是一张表而不是下拉框（每个 gguf 一行，带体积和偏大提示），选之前能看清磁盘上到底有什么。0.4.4 起 provider 表上的删除键删的是这条 provider 配置，不是磁盘上的权重文件。这个区别很重要：真正想清掉的是那种僵尸条目 —— 指向一个从没应答过的端口、同一个端口注册了两遍、或者模型文件早就删了还留着的那几条，而不是一个 15.8GB 的 gguf。删配置随时可以重新导入，删 gguf 不行。删除走settings.mutate 的 unset，路径是 \['providers', id]：不能用 update，因为 update 是合并层，往那儿写null 只会留下一个 null 的 provider 键，loader 会当成配置坏了而不是「没有这一条」；只有 mutate 的unset 内部是 Reflect.deleteProperty。删完会回读一次，因为对「来自下层（profile 的 cordis.patch.yml或 home patch）的键」做 unset 不是删除而是恢复继承值 —— 调用成功但条目还在。条目还在时面板会直说，并把该改哪个文件指出来，不谎报成功；settings 服务太老没有 mutate() 的版本也会明说，而不是默默忽略。删除要点两次，点别的行就撤回确认；删成功会清掉在线缓存与 baseURL 缓存并重算工具面，因为 provider列表变了。gguf 本身插件一个字节都不动 —— 扫描出来的那张表只用来展示和选中。且显存能不能读到取决于驱动。0.4.5 起模型扫描也读 Ollama 自己的存储：它的 blob 叫 sha256-… 、没有后缀，光按扩展名永远列不出来。现在认权重看后缀或文件头 GGUF 魔数（只开「无点号且 ≥8MB」的文件，一趟最多读 600 次魔数；.json/.md/.safetensors/.part 这类明显不是权重的后缀一次都不开）。Ollama 的模型从 manifest 还原：只取 mediaType 为 application/vnd.ollama.image.model 的层（mmproj/adapter 层不算主模型），人话名从 manifest 路径还原（…/qwen3/8b → qwen3:8b，latest 不加冒号），同一份 blob 被多个 tag 引用时合并成一行，metadata 的 kv 给出名称、量化和 context 上限。对 Ollama 的模型点「一键配置」不会再拿同一份权重重复起一份 llama-server：它确认 11434 上的 ollama 在应答（不在就 ollama serve），并按端点自己报的 tag 注册 provider —— 11434 上报的是 qwen3:14b，拿 blob 的 sha256 名永远匹配不上。顺带修掉两个只有真机才暴露的坑：Windows 上 existsSync('<文件>/') 返回 true，manifest 与目录的分岔改成按内容判定，不再依赖尾斜杠语义；量化标签表照搬了旧一代 ggml 枚举，把 ggml_type 15 标成 Q5_K_S，而 ollama show 实测报 Q4_K_M，整表按真实序号重写。同一份文件的去重按 (dev,ino)，谁有名字留谁。参考机实测：扫描从 1 行变 4 行 —— qwen3:14b（8.64G）与 qwen3:8b（4.87G）带着 Q4_K_M 徽标出现 —— 耗时 4ms；npm run verify 退出码 0（launcher 57 项、portable 35 项、panel-host 含 linux/darwin 模拟平台两套全绿）；panel-host 新增的用法在 tmpdir 里现造一份迷你 Ollama 存储再把 OLLAMA_MODELS 指过去，测试结果不再取决于跑测试的机器装没装 ollama。0.4.6 起面板显示的是模型自己的真名，不再是文件名：有些下载工具会把任何权重都落成同一个通用文件名，真名只写在 GGUF 头部里。扫描会读每个文件的 GGUF KV 区 —— 不是先读一段固定大小的头部，因为 tokenizer.ggml.tokens（大 MoE 模型动辄几十万条字符串）和 chat_template 会把 general.file_type 挤出任何窗口；而且 GGUF 的字符串数组是交错存储（每条 u64 长度加载荷），把它当长度表读会让游标跑偏、算出天文数字的读取量。读与走位分开记账：键名与类型必读，超过 256KB 的字符串值和字符串数组只走位不复制，非字符串数组超过 64 个元素直接跳过，游标越过文件末尾立刻停 —— 越界说明游标错了，不是该把上限调大。显示名依次取 Ollama 的 tag、general.basename 加 size_label、general.name、文件名，整串留在悬停里因为常带内部编号；视觉投影文件现在也靠 general.type 认，不只看文件名。短读（文件被截断）不再把半截字节喂给解析器。参考机实测：读一个文件的头部解析出 44 个键耗时约 16ms，整趟扫描约 31ms。0.4.7 起「试跑」不再出现「第一次失败、第二次成功」。老代码让两轮请求共用一个 AbortController 和一个 30 秒定时器，也就是两轮加起来只有 30 秒：大模型的冷加载第一轮就烧完它，abort 之后 signal 永久处于已中止状态，第二轮（换成 Ollama 认的 reasoning_effort: none 再试一次）连请求都发不出去 —— 这正是第一次点报 This operation was aborted、第二次却能成功的原因。现在每轮各自一个 controller 和定时器；超时自动再来一轮（retryOnTimeout 默认开），因为第一次请求超时几乎总是「权重还在读盘」；非超时错误（连不上、HTTP 报错）完全不重试。超时也会自己说清楚：文案里写明超过了多少秒、是否已自动重试，并指向新增的「试跑超时（秒）」配置项（默认 60，可设 5-600）—— 端口通了不等于能出字，它和「拉起后等端口（秒）」是两个不同的旋钮。顺带：面板提示里那句绑定某一个具体模型的举例去掉了，不是每台机器都下了那个模型，说明改成讲机制。0.4.8 起「一键配置」一个普通 .gguf 不再注册出不相干的 Ollama 模型。端口这一栏原来跟着上一次点击走而不是跟着文件走：选中 Ollama 的条目会把端口挪到 11434，选中普通 .gguf 时却不挪回来，于是一次先前点击留下的 11434 就一直留着。服务端照单全收，去探那个端口，发现 Ollama 在应答就直接借了它（日志里那句「端口本来就在应答，跳过拉起」就是这条路径），接着按文件名拼出来的模型 id 在 Ollama 的 /v1/models 里对不上，而兜底是抓列表里的第一个 —— embedding 模型往往排在第一位，于是注册出了一个用户从没点过的模型。现在端口跟着文件走：普通 .gguf 落在别的引擎的端口上（ollama 11434、vLLM 8000、LM Studio 1234）就改到 8090 并在面板里说明一句；只改「已知引擎的端口」，自己手填 9999 指向另一台 llama-server 的情况一概不动。模型 id 的兜底也不再瞎猜：只有一个条目时才取它（单模型后端报的 id 本来就可能和文件名不同），有多个而对不上就报错并列出实际看到的 id，而不是注册出一个错的 provider。0.4.9 起面板不会再整块消失。以前插件详情页里那一块可能凭空不见，而宿主照常运行、HTTP bridge 照常应答、连崩溃日志都不留一条。原因是一个作用域错误：某个辅助函数声明在一个组件里面，却被另一个组件引用 —— 这是合法 JavaScript，语法检查完全通过，于是它只在渲染期炸，也就是用户按下扫描按钮、React 执行状态更新函数的那一瞬间。宿主给每个插槽条目都包了一层错误边界，兜底渲染是一个空的锚点，所以异常被就地吞掉：插件没有被卸载、进程也没有崩，面板只是被换成了一个空 div。现在这两个辅助函数放在两个组件共享的模块作用域里。客户端这一半也有了专门的用例 —— 一个最小 React 替身载入真正的面板模块，真调用组件、真在渲染期执行状态更新函数、真去按扫描按钮，这类错误不会再走到发布版里。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration hub: bridges six foreign agent runtimes (Codex, Claude Code, OMP, Pi, Hermes, Antigravity) into the DSH Web UI — roster, session create/prompt/resume, exec/PTY/task/file lanes, local or cross-machine over SSH/Docker/Incus/Hub. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: Multi-agent 编排中枢：把六个外部 agent 运行时（Codex、Claude Code、OMP、Pi、Hermes、Antigravity）接入 DSH Web UI——roster、会话 create/prompt/resume、exec/PTY/task/file 通道，本机或跨机（SSH/Docker/Incus/Hub）。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.zh: 第三方 DSH 插件检查与更新增强工具，启动后台探测并在侧边栏与已安装列表展示更新角标（原生弹窗更新完成后自动同步消隐），支持 GitHub 仓库及分支/标签（#ref）、固定 commit 解锁与 monorepo 子路径的 CDN 并发竞速检测与升级，提供 npm/npmmirror/自定义源切换与官方源回退、minimumReleaseAge 观察期绕过、快照与离线回滚对齐，以及默认让位原生与按需开启详情页更新按钮。

description.en: Appends one short user message before the next step when the model is circling: the same absolute path written three times with no measurement landing in between, the same error episode (tool, target and normalised fingerprint) returning twice, or a write followed by two steps with no measurement — the last one only arms, and the message lands before the next write rather than interrupting reading. A measurement has two states: intent is judged from the tool arguments at call time, and the write streak is cleared only when the result comes back, only for that command directory. A failed test still counts, because it yields the line that is wrong. Hard measurements are `lsp_diagnostics`, `verify`, `run_tests` and `run_test`; `ops_bash`, `bash`, `shell` and `pwsh` count only when the command matches a measurement pattern, so `ls` no longer launders a blind edit streak. Signals fire once per episode, re-arm after a real measurement, and are capped per turn; a successful `present` sleeps the gate until the next write, and subagent sessions are skipped. Generated paths (build output, lock files, logs) are excluded. Error targets are read out of real `file:///` ESM stacks, so two different files never collapse into one episode, and `cd <dir> && cmd` counts as a measurement of that directory rather than its parent. Ships the `stuck-gate` skill at bundled rank 600 (a user-level copy at 400 overrides its wording) plus a read-only observation panel at `/better-debug` reporting firings, sessions covered, the first action after each message across six classes, and how many measurement loops actually closed. The log defaults to `$DSH_HOME/logs/better-debug.log` and is created on first write, so the panel has data right after install. Optional host services are subscribed dynamically, so a host without them still loads the gate. It does not estimate tokens saved, and it does not claim the message caused the change. The panel banner counts only the failures after the most recent load (`log.current`), so one old mount failure no longer reads as "currently disabled". Test suites wait for log conditions instead of fixed delays (test-only change in 0.2.5).
description.zh: 模型打转时，在下一步之前追加一条简短用户消息：同一绝对路径连续写了三次而中间没有任何测量落地、同一个错误 episode（工具、目标、归一化指纹）第二次出现、或一次写入后过了两步仍无测量——第三种只先上膛，消息在**下一次写入之前**才落，不打断阅读。测量拆成两态：调用时按工具参数判意图，结果回来了才清零，且只清与该命令目录相关的文件。失败的测试同样算测量，因为它给出了错在哪一行。硬测量是 `lsp_diagnostics`、`verify`、`run_tests`、`run_test`；`ops_bash`、`bash`、`shell`、`pwsh` 只有命令命中测量模式才算，所以 `ls` 不再能洗白盲改计数。每条信号每个 episode 一次，真测量后重新武装，每回合有总预算；`present` 成功后闸门休眠到下一次写入；子会话跳过。生成物（构建产物、锁文件、日志）不计入；错误目标能从真实的 `file:///` ESM 栈里读出来，两个不同文件不会塌成同一个 episode；`cd <目录> && 命令` 算那个目录的测量，不再算成它的父目录。自带 `stuck-gate` 技能（bundled rank 600，用户级 400 的同名技能可覆盖措辞），并附只读观测面板 `/better-debug`：数触发次数、覆盖会话、每条消息之后第一个动作的六类分布、以及真正闭合的测量回路数量。日志默认写 `$DSH_HOME/logs/better-debug.log` 并在首次写入时创建，装完面板就有数据。可选宿主服务走动态订阅，缺少它们的宿主也能正常加载。不估算省下的 token，也不声称这条消息导致了改变。面板横幅只数最近一次加载之后的失败（`log.current`），历史里挂过一次不会再显示成「当前被关闭」。测试读日志改成等条件、不等固定时长（0.2.5 只有测试改动，行为不变）。

description.en: Project-scoped deterministic execution trace memory and zero-token session digest plugin for DSH (v0.3.0), compiling session histories via temporal causal slicing and AST symbol attribution into guarded L0/L1/L2 playbooks with inline session_id lineage. Registers /tmem (status, list, forget, gc, telemetry, bench, evaluate, inspect, replay, diff, sync), recalls memories in agent/pre-step only on explicit file-path or error anchors (skipping unchanged repeated steps), and intercepts tools/post-execute errors and code edits with same-origin L2 fixes, failure-loop warnings, statistical L1 co-change partner hints, and runtime adoption telemetry (skipping idle read calls). Requires Python 3 on PATH (or TMEM_PYTHON) and spawns python3 -m tmem.cli asynchronously with a 5-second timeout; stores all data strictly inside each project's .tmem/ directory (no ~/.tmem/ global store) and makes no network requests. Needs Python 3 on PATH (or TMEM_PYTHON); it runs python3 -m tmem on every agent step and tool result.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的项目级确定性执行轨迹记忆与零额外 token 历史会话摘要插件（v0.3.0），通过时间因果切片与 AST 符号归因将会话提炼为带守卫条件的 L0/L1/L2 执行剧本及内联 session_id 溯源摘要。注册 /tmem 命令（status、list、forget、gc、telemetry、bench、evaluate、inspect、replay、diff、sync），在 agent/pre-step 仅基于显式文件路径或报错锚点召回记忆（跳过输入未变的重复步骤），并在 tools/post-execute 对报错和代码修改提供同源 L2 修复、死循环熔断警告、统计 L1 共变搭档提醒与采纳率遥测（空闲时跳过常规读取工具）。需要 PATH 中有 Python 3（或设置 TMEM_PYTHON），通过异步子进程调用 python3 -m tmem.cli（超时 5 秒）；所有数据仅存于各项目 .tmem/ 目录（无 ~/.tmem/ 全局存储），不发任何网络请求。需要 PATH 里有 Python 3（或设置 TMEM_PYTHON），并在每个 agent 步骤和每条工具结果上同步运行 python3 -m tmem。

description.en: Blocks the end of a turn while temporary files from that turn are still lying around: it registers a listener on the serial agent/turn-stopping hook and, if anything is left, hands the model the file list plus two ways out — delete them, or justify each one and move it somewhere deliberate. Candidates come from two narrow temp-file sources, plus a backup-retention channel that is on by default and flags excess .bak copies of files touched this turn. The first is the .agent-tmp/ convention directory under the session cwd: whatever is left in it is reported outright, because that directory exists only for throwaway files. The second is the paths this turn actually wrote, captured through the fs/write-intent, fs/edit-intent and fs/delete-intent hooks; those are reported only when they sit under that cwd (compared after realpath normalisation), fall outside .git, node_modules, out, dist, build, target, vendor, .venv and the Python bytecode cache directory, match a temp-file pattern that requires a separator after the prefix so checkout.js and benchmark.ts are not taken for scratch files, and the file is still present — which keeps junk already sitting in the workspace from being resurrected as a complaint about this turn. One gate per turn, subagent sessions skipped, nothing deleted unless the backup mode is explicitly set to prune, and the injected wording follows the host locale instead of assuming a Chinese one.
description.zh: 临时文件没清完，这一轮就结束不了：在串行的 agent/turn-stopping 钩子上挂监听器，发现残留就把文件清单交回模型，并给两条出路——删掉，或者逐条说明理由再挪到明确位置。候选有两处很窄的临时件来源，另有一条默认开启的备份保留通道：本轮碰过的 .bak 副本超过保留份数会被列出。第一处是会话 cwd 下的 .agent-tmp/ 约定目录，留在里面的文件一律直接报出，因为这个目录的存在意义就是装可丢的东西。第二处是本轮经 fs/write-intent、fs/edit-intent、fs/delete-intent 钩子真实写入的路径，还要同时满足：在那个 cwd 之下（按 realpath 归一后比较）、不落在 .git / node_modules / out / dist / build / target / vendor / .venv / the Python bytecode cache directory 里、命中要求前缀后带分隔符的临时件模式（所以 checkout.js 与 benchmark.ts 不会被当成草稿）、且文件此刻仍在——正因如此，工作区里早就躺着的垃圾不会被翻出来当成本轮的问题。每轮只拦一次，子会话跳过，除非把备份模式显式设成 prune 否则插件自己不删文件，注入文案跟随宿主语言环境而不是假定中文。

It signs in with the second account's cookies, kept in ~/.hykb-ai/credentials.json, and posts under that account on a public forum; replies to your @-mentions run once started, while auto-posting, auto-replying to high-score threads and auto-liking are off by default, so check the forum's rules on automated accounts.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 自己刷快爆 —— 会消息、写日报，遇到值得看的会点赞。它用小号的 cookie 登录（保存在 ~/.hykb-ai/credentials.json），并以该账号在公开论坛发言；启动后会自动回复 @ 你的通知，而自动发帖、自动回复高分帖和自动点赞默认关闭，请先确认论坛对自动化账号的规定。

description.en: Financial workbench for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): turns new sessions into a finance-mode assistant with FTShare China stock market data, quotes and financial statements, Kline (K-line) candlestick charts with technical indicators, inline plotting, and a paper trading simulator for A-share stocks and commodity futures.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的金融工作台：新会话默认进入金融模式，带 FTShare 股票行情、报价与财报数据，K线图表、蜡烛图与技术指标，内联出图，以及 A股/商品期货模拟交易（模拟盘）。

description.en: Recovers socket cause chains, key HTTP response headers, and size-limited error bodies from failed DSH model requests, shows them next to the native error, and adds bounded extra retries for model and compaction requests.
description.zh: 还原 DSH 失败请求的异常原因链、关键响应头和限长错误正文，与原生报错并排展示，并为普通请求和压缩请求提供次数受限的额外重试。

description.en: Chinese prose "AI-flavor" detector in the right sidebar: a local rule engine scores and highlights template phrasing, uniform sentence rhythm, vague imagery and repetition, with a separate typo-check page; the score is always computed locally. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 中文「AI 味」检测器：右侧栏面板，本地规则引擎打分并标出套话、句式均匀、缺画面感与重复，另设错字页；分数始终由本地算。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Shows AMD Radeon Cloud AI Capacity for every Radeon model — a per-model badge in the model picker, and the selected model's capacity on the same row as its name. The badges register only once a Radeon provider is configured, so they never displace the host's own model annotations. Quota is display-only, since AMD is currently free and unmetered. Its settings page can also write the provider into the DSH user layer, so the provider keeps working after the plugin is uninstalled. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 显示 AMD Radeon Cloud 的 AI Capacity：模型选择器里每个模型一枚容量徽章，当前模型的容量与模型名同一行。徽章只在配好 Radeon provider 之后才注册，因此不会顶掉内核自带的模型标注。额度仅作展示（AMD 目前免费不限量）。设置页还可以把 provider 写进 DSH 用户层，卸载本插件后依然可用。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Evolution mode in one package: a thinking mode that aligns on your goal and boundaries each turn plus the task tree, profile injection and panel, alignment-bar styling, self-check tools and plan-mode entry — install one package and you have the whole set. It helps the model understand requests more accurately, get noticeably better results at the same cost, and build a long-term profile of your preferences. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 进化模式一包装全：一个每轮先对齐目标与边界的思维模式，连任务树、画像注入与面板、对齐栏样式、自查工具、计划模式入口一起装；装一个包就是整套。让模型更准确地理解你的需求、用相同的花费做出明显更好的效果，并长期积累你的偏好。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: One sidebar panel listing every local coding agent's sessions (DSH, codex, opencode, WorkBuddy, Gemini, ZCode, MiniMax) with real titles and turn-based status, read from local stores only. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 左侧栏一个面板看全本机 coding agent 的会话（DSH/codex/opencode/WorkBuddy/Gemini/ZCode/MiniMax），标题和状态都取自各自的本地记录，只读本地、零 token。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Compatibility fork of the Hermes ↔ DSH bridge, working on dsh 0.2.x: receives Hermes-dispatched tasks over JSON-RPC and SSE, exposes 16 DSH-side tools for importing, consulting and dispatching to Hermes, mirrors DSH sessions to Hermes with redaction, and adds a link doctor plus metrics endpoints. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them. Its HTTP routes accept task dispatch without a token unless you set HERMES_LINK_TOKEN, and have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: Hermes ↔ DSH 双向桥接插件的兼容性分支，可在 dsh 0.2.x 上运行：接收 Hermes 下发的任务（JSON-RPC 与 SSE），提供 16 个 DSH 侧工具用于导入会话、咨询 Hermes 与向 Hermes 派单，支持带脱敏的会话镜像，并附带链路诊断与指标接口。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由在你设置 HERMES_LINK_TOKEN 之前不要求令牌就能下发任务，也没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Douyin patent and trademark complaint workflow for DeepSeek Harness with a left-sidebar task panel: checks user-supplied links, materials and organization identity in a dedicated browser, records each submission state, queries platform history read-only, and shows local task counts in the sidebar; never discovers targets or submits without explicit authorization.
description.zh: 抖音专利/商标侵权举报插件：左侧栏任务面板 + 专用浏览器核对本次链接、证明材料与组织身份，记录提交状态，只读查询平台历史回执；不自动发现举报对象，未明确授权不提交。

description.en: Keyboard shortcuts for DSH Desktop: return to the conversation, focus the composer, switch pages, open DevTools, and an Alt+Tab style session switcher that previews sessions while Alt is held and switches on release (DSH NEXT on Windows).
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的快捷键插件：返回会话、聚焦输入框、切换功能页、打开 DevTools，以及 Alt+Tab 风格的会话轮切板——按住 Alt 预览会话，松开即切换（DSH NEXT + Windows）。

description.en: Checks installed plugins against a DSH update before you install it, and reports the shared UI members and host services they use that the new version no longer exports — the case where an update installs cleanly but leaves plugins failing to load. Includes a read-only diagnose command. Windows only, DSH desktop, Node.js 18+.
description.zh: 在装 DSH 更新之前，把已装插件用到的共享 UI 成员和宿主服务，与新版本实际导出的逐项比对，列出新版本不再提供的那几个——也就是「更新装上了、插件却加载不起来」那种。附一个只读 diagnose 命令。仅支持 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，需要 Node.js 18+。

description.en: Self-contained vision for text-only DSH models: registers its own vision_read_image tool (verbatim OCR, reading-order layout, semantics, uncertainty), turns pasted images into local file paths through a capture-phase paste channel with rolling storage, and optionally exposes a loopback OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Talks to your own upstream directly, with no external vision CLI and no runtime dependency. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的纯文本模型自带一双眼睛：注册自己的 vision_read_image 工具（逐字 OCR、阅读顺序版面、语义、不确定项），粘贴图片在捕获阶段转成本机路径并滚动保留最近若干张，另可选暴露一个本机 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容端点；直接连接你自己的上游，不依赖任何外部视觉 CLI，也没有运行时依赖。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Project, session and todo workbench for the DeepSeekRuntime web UI: projects in grid or list view with rename, pin, favorite, archive and restore; sessions browsed per project with body preview, rename, archive and delete; todos with priority, Markdown notes, image or file attachments, search and filters. State is kept in a plugin-owned host storage domain (dsh_workbase). 11 agent tools read and update todos of the project the calling session belongs to using version-checked writes, and the same panel covers project diagnostics, plugin updates and encrypted backup and restore.
description.zh: DeepSeekRuntime Web 端的工作台插件：宫格或列表管理项目（改名、置顶、收藏、归档与恢复），按项目浏览会话并预览正文、改名／归档／删除，待办支持优先级、Markdown 备注、图片与文件附件、搜索与筛选。状态存放在插件自己的宿主存储域 dsh_workbase。注册 11 个 Agent 工具，按版本校验读写会话所属项目的待办；同一面板还提供项目诊断、插件更新与加密备份恢复。

description.en: A proactive coding agent as a DSH bundle: it listens to GitHub issues and comments, and optionally Feishu, DingTalk and WeCom, turns requests from authorized people into tickets, runs each ticket in its own DSH session and git worktree, and replies in the original thread with a branch or pull request.
description.zh: 以 DSH bundle 形式发布的主动式编码智能体：监听 GitHub 的 issue 与评论，也可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信，把有权限的人提出的请求开成工单，每条工单在自己的 DSH 会话与 git worktree 里执行，并回到原话题以分支或 PR 回话。

description.en: DSH plugin for Gaussian 16: SMILES-to-3D, input generation, serial job management, output parsing, and Multiwfn/VMD post-processing (orbital/ESP/RDG).
description.zh: Gaussian 16 计算辅助插件：SMILES→3D 建模、输入生成、串行任务管理、输出解析，以及 Multiwfn/VMD 后处理（轨道/ESP/RDG 出图）。

description.en: Renders ask-user-question as a previewable choice dialog: URL, local-path and inline HTML/PHP previews, per-option notes and hints, a quiz mode that only shows right/wrong scores, and six UI locales.
description.zh: 把 ask-user-question 变成可预览的选择弹窗：支持 URL、本地路径、内联 HTML/PHP 预览，选项可写备注与查看提示，测验模式只显示对错和得分，界面支持六种语言。

description.en: Sync team models, agent presets, and approved plugins into DeepSeek Harness, with team-scoped assistant operations.
description.zh: 将团队模型、智能体预设和审批后的插件同步到 DeepSeek Harness，并提供绑定团队的助理操作。

description.en: Pack DSH conversations and workspaces into one .dshpack file and restore them on another machine or platform, with cross-platform path repair.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的对话与工作区打包成单个 .dshpack 文件，换台电脑或换个平台继续用，并自动处理跨平台路径。

description.en: An always-on attention pill in the session header. One glance shows how many sessions are waiting on you — approvals, questions, and failures — and what you already declined. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 会话头部的常驻注意力胶囊：一眼看到还有几个会话在等你——待批准、待回答、出错，以及你已经拒掉的事。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Copy an assistant message as Markdown, plain text, rich text for Word, TSV, LaTeX or a JSON block tree, from a per-message button or the chat context menu.
description.zh: 从消息操作栏按钮或聊天右键菜单，把助手消息复制为 Markdown、纯文本、可直接粘到 Word 的富文本、TSV、LaTeX 或 JSON 块树。

description.en: Interactive terminal tab in the Conversation view row: one persistent shell per session opened straight in its working directory, reload reconnects with the screen intact, and an explicit close stays closed across refreshes. Shares its shells and default-shell setting with the sidebar terminal.
description.zh: 对话视图栏的可交互终端 tab：每个会话一个持久 shell、直接进入会话工作目录、刷新后自动重连且屏幕保留、显式关闭跨刷新保持。与侧栏终端共用同一套 shell 和默认 Shell 设置。

description.en: Exports a single dsh assistant reply into a SiYuan notebook as a structured Markdown note, with sections split by heading, icon-tagged bullet points and code blocks kept as-is. A button on every assistant message opens a dialog with a model-generated editable title and a document-tree picker, or runs silently and reports the result in a toast. SiYuan only and export-only, with no sync back.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的单条助手回复导出为思源笔记里的结构化 Markdown：按二级标题分节、要点带小图标、代码块原样保留。每条助手回复的操作栏都有导出按钮，弹窗里可用模型生成并编辑主题名、在文档树里选择存放位置，也可以静默导出并用 toast 报告结果。仅支持思源、仅单向导出，不做反向同步。

description.en: Desktop pet for HoloCubic: mirrors your DeepSeek Harness agent state over LAN SSE, with 114 animations, two screens and an on-device skin editor.
description.zh: HoloCubic 桌搭屏的桌面宠物：通过局域网 SSE 同步 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 状态，含 114 个动作、两个界面和设备端皮肤编辑器。

description.en: A functional betta desktop companion for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: it follows several concurrent sessions at once, can switch a session to full access for the moment and restore the default permission automatically once the work is done, and adds a panel to send a line, stop a turn, or approve inline — size and colour are adjustable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面里的功能性斗鱼桌宠：可同时查看多个并行会话的进展，必要时一键临时提权到完全访问、任务完成自动恢复默认权限；面板可直接递话、喊停、就地报批，大小与配色可调。

description.en: Control local VMware Workstation, Player and Fusion virtual machines — power, snapshots, live CPU and memory, network layout and VMX parameters, with one-step SSH import into dsh-ssh-vault.
description.zh: 管理本机 VMware Workstation / Player / Fusion 虚拟机：电源、快照、实时 CPU 与内存、网络配置与 VMX 参数，并可一键把 SSH 接入导入 dsh-ssh-vault。

description.en: Adds a pending-decision board to the session header: agents record a decision as they ask it, the board lists each entry with its options and their costs, clicking one fills the composer with a reply like "Q-2 选 B" without sending it, and a user message that answers an entry marks it decided. Each session keeps its own file, so boards never leak across sessions.
description.zh: 在会话标题行加一个待拍板看板：agent 提问时顺手把决策记进去，看板列出每条决策的选项与各自代价，点选项只把「Q-2 选 B」这样的回复填进输入框而不发送，人回答后条目自动标记为已定。每个会话一份数据，看板之间互不可见。

description.en: A sidebar context-menu action and a session_rename_ai tool, both regenerating a session title from its own human messages with the model that session last used.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话右键菜单加「根据对话重新命名」，并提供 session_rename_ai 工具，用该会话自己最后使用的模型按其人类消息重写标题。

description.en: Workspace tidy-up plugin: moves stray temp files, render leftovers and generated scripts into a hidden .dsh folder at the end of each turn, keeping the workspace root clean without blocking or deleting anything.
description.zh: 工作区自动整理插件：每轮结束时把根目录的临时文件、渲染产物和生成脚本收进隐藏的 .dsh 目录，不拦截、不删除，让工作区保持整洁。

description.en: Takes over the left rail of DeepSeek Harness: reorder panels by dragging, rename them, swap in one of 24 built-in icons, hide them, and merge several into one group row that opens a member menu. Configuration applies instantly and survives restarts, and an existing dsh-panellist configuration can be imported in one click. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 的左侧栏：拖拽排序、改名、换成 24 个内置图标之一、隐藏，以及把多个面板合并成一行（点开是成员菜单）。改动即时生效、重启后保留；可以一键导入已有的 dsh-panellist 配置。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Turns English passages and exam papers into Chinese analysis — paragraph-by-paragraph translation, bilingual questions with answers traced to the source, error analysis, long-sentence syntax breakdown — rendered live in a sidebar panel inside DeepSeek Harness, with an optional A4 PDF export. Windows, macOS and Linux. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把英语文章与试卷转成中文分析：逐段翻译、题目与选项中英对照并给出答案、作答错因归类、长难句句法拆解；在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏面板内实时渲染，可按需导出 A4 PDF。Windows / macOS / Linux 均可用。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: It replaces the composer's conversation.input.model seat with a single flat panel rendered in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 它把会话输入框中的 conversation.input.model 控件替换成一个平铺面板，渲染在 Web GUI 内。

description.en: Generates a structured handoff card so a near-full conversation continues in a fresh zero-context session: /handoff writes the card, numbers the new title per conversation line, pins it to the top of the sidebar, prepares the new session once the context nears its threshold, and can run /handoff automatically at a configurable threshold (50-95 percent, default 90).
description.zh: 用 /handoff 生成交接卡，让快满的对话在全新零上下文会话里接着跑：标题按会话线自动编号、卡片在侧栏置顶、接近阈值时自动备好新会话，也能按可配置阈值（50-95%，默认 90%）自动执行 /handoff。

description.en: Two-line session cards for the sidebar: per-workspace project tiles (monogram, emoji, color or image), pinning, hand or timed archiving with a collapsible archived shelf, running and waiting status markers, per-session background-job and subagent counts, and newest-input-first sorting. Web GUI; requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or later.
description.zh: 侧栏两行会话卡片：按工作区显示项目图标（字母、emoji、颜色或图片）、置顶、手动或定时归档与可折叠归档架、运行/等待状态标记、按会话的后台任务与子代理计数、按最近输入排序。面向 Web GUI，需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上。

description.en: A DSH plugin that provides API-free image generation capabilities. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 免费 API 图像生成插件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: AgentScope Platform inside DeepSeek Harness: manage several platform accounts (switch the billing account by hand, pick one by remaining Credits, probe and flag unhealthy ones), an optional OpenAI-compatible model provider whose catalog you can fetch, add to and edit row by row, an available-Credits and redeemable-contribution readout under the composer, and a settings panel for the daily check-in, the balance, contribution grants, usage detail and the price list. Switching accounts affects new requests only and never interrupts a session already in flight.
description.zh: 把 AgentScope Platform 接入 DSH：管理多个平台账号（手动切换计费账号、按额度自动选号、测活与健康标记），可自行开关的 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商（模型目录可自动获取、手动添加并逐行修改元数据），输入框下方的可用 Credits 与可兑换贡献值读数，以及包含每日签到、额度、贡献值、用量明细与价目表的设置面板。切换账号只影响新请求，不会打断正在进行的会话。

description.en: Transparent Markdown long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: tiered facts, background extraction, BM25 search, persona editing, and a heartbeat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供透明的 Markdown 长期记忆：分层事实、后台提炼、BM25 检索、人格编辑与心跳。

description.en: Directional non-linear motion for the DSH web UI — menus, dialogs, lists, sidebars, chat and micro-interactions.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加上方向性非线性动效，菜单、弹窗、列表、侧边栏和聊天都有顺滑动画。

description.en: bgjobs 的可选扩展插件：把 一次 MCP 工具调用 提交成由 schtasks 托管的后台任务，并提供 MCP server 的登记、预热与设置页。
description.zh: 把 MCP 工具调用丢给 schtasks 在后台跑，还能登记、预热 MCP server 并统一管理设置。

description.en: Adds a Codex switch under the chat input: with it on, a session hands coding requests to the local Codex CLI, which writes the implementation prompt and reviews the result, while dsh-baton runs the work in a Harness session and returns the changed files, test results and a requirement checklist. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在输入框下方加一个 Codex 开关：点亮后该会话的编码需求交给本机 Codex CLI 理解、写实现提示词并验收，实现由 dsh-baton 派给 Harness 会话执行，最后回报改动文件、测试结果和逐条需求对照。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DaFeiYu Voice Ball: a floating desktop voice companion - click the ball, say one sentence, and it answers out loud. Local Whisper ASR + edge-tts synthesis over a live RuiC-2D animated character; ollama, DSH or DeepSeek LLM backends; standalone Electron window with first-run auto-setup (clones the character engine, creates a venv, installs dependencies).
description.zh: 大肥鱼语音球：桌面悬浮语音伴侣——点一下球说一句话，它开口回答一句。本地 Whisper 识别 + edge-tts 合成，RuiC-2D 实时角色渲染；支持 ollama / DSH / DeepSeek 三种回答后端；独立 Electron 窗口，首次运行自动配置环境（克隆角色引擎、建 venv、装依赖）。

description.en: Node-based image and video generation canvas for DeepSeek Harness: 16 built-in nodes and 5 example workflows, chat and project canvases, AI workflow building, cloud Model Studio image/video models, optional local ComfyUI, local safetensors weight inspection, trusted-source model downloads, and per-run token usage.
description.zh: 节点式图像/视频生成工作流画布：内置 16 个节点与 5 个示例工作流，支持聊天与项目画布、AI 自动搭建工作流、云端 Model Studio 生图生视频、可选本地 ComfyUI、本地 safetensors 权重检查、可信源模型下载与单次运行 Token 用量统计。

description.en: Ascend NPU fleet monitor plus controlled vLLM container deployment for DeepSeek Harness. Environments come from envs.json; npu-smi is collected locally or over SSH with one connection per environment. The sidebar shows idle/partial/busy occupancy, processes, and per-card/per-chip details, and lets you preview or start a vLLM container on selected idle NPU chips. Preview is read-only; real start requires deploy.allowRealExecution plus a confirmation token, only touches dsh-apf-svc-* containers, binds ports to 127.0.0.1, and never stops other users' containers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的昇腾 NPU 多环境占用看板 + 受控 vLLM 容器服务：环境从 envs.json 读取，通过本机或 SSH 只读采集 npu-smi（每环境一条连接），侧栏显示空闲/部分/高负载、占用进程与逐卡逐 chip 详情；可在选定环境的空闲 NPU chip 上预览/启动 vLLM 容器。预览为只读，真实启动需 deploy.allowRealExecution + 确认令牌，只操作 dsh-apf-svc-* 自有容器，端口只绑 127.0.0.1，不停止他人容器。

description.en: Claude-style folders, fork trees and drag-and-drop for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, plus ZIP export and AI chat titles
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加上类 Claude 的文件夹、分叉树和拖拽整理，还能导出 ZIP、自动起 AI 会话标题。

description.en: Full-screen settings page with a collapsible navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness (placeholder release).
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的设置弹窗变成全屏页面，侧边导航栏还能收成图标列，设置起来更顺手。

description.en: 星火课堂 — DSH 插件：B 站少儿科普片库 + 每周排片 + 课卡答题 + 错题本 + 勋章盲盒 + 家长锁 | Spark Classroom — a DSH plugin for curated Bilibili learning: weekly schedule, quiz cards, mistakes review, medals, parent lock
description.zh: 给孩子的 B 站学习面板：家长挑片排课，孩子看片答题，错题回炉，还有勋章盲盒和防沉迷家长锁。

description.en: Breeze TTS for DeepSeek Harness: AI auto-read (local runtime) plus voice workshop — design, clone and manage voices.
description.zh: 让 AI 自动朗读回复，还能设计、克隆和管理专属音色，本地运行更安心。

description.en: A ChatGPT-desktop-style skin for the DSH Web GUI: Chat and Work modes, projects and sessions sidebar, pixel-matched composer and messages, light and dark. All native DSH capabilities stay intact — steps, tasks, goals, file outputs — identical with or without the skin.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面套上 ChatGPT 桌面版外观，聊天和工作模式、侧边栏、明暗主题都有，功能一点不变。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: mirrors a GitHub .NET skill catalog (default managedcode/dotnet-skills) into the DSH user skill root every 6 hours.
description.zh: 每6小时把 GitHub 上的 .NET 技能库同步到 DSH，还能按项目自动挑出合适的技能。

description.en: Stars for models in the DeepSeek Harness model picker plus a Favourites block for quick switching
description.zh: 在模型选择器里给模型加星标，并单独列出收藏区，常用模型一键切换。

description.en: dsh-floating-ball
description.zh: 在界面最上层浮一颗可拖拽的快捷球，随手新建会话、切侧栏、换主题、回对话。

description.en: Use DeepSeek Harness (DSH) from iPhone/iPad over Tailscale: full native workspaces and sessions, no LAN or same Wi-Fi required, encrypted, no DSH modification.
description.zh: 用 iPhone 或 iPad 通过 Tailscale 远程使用 DSH 桌面端，自动适配移动端布局，不用同一 Wi-Fi。

description.en: dsh插件：ai知识库
description.zh: 把零散资料编译成互相链接的 Obsidian 知识库页面，越用越有条理。

description.en: 文献知识库：收文、精读、证据链、横向对比、可追溯检索
description.zh: 把文献收进来精读、建证据链、做横向对比，还能追溯问答和辅助写作的本地知识库。

description.en: 宇宙无敌背景 · 7 套动态场景 + 星尘 / 流星 / 光标光晕 / 雪花，给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的壁纸插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端加会动的壁纸，7 套动态场景配星尘、流星、光标光晕和雪花，纯 CSS 与 Canvas 绘制，不联网不占资源。

description.en: Markdown rendering inside the DeepSeek Harness composer: finished lines render in place, code gets token colours, lists continue and renumber, pasted blocks render — the composer itself stays untouched.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里直接渲染 Markdown，边打字边看到代码配色、列表续号和粘贴块效果，输入框本身不变。

description.en: MCP server console for DeepSeek Harness: live status, probe, restart, edit MCP servers in place
description.zh: 给 MCP 服务器配个可视化控制台，实时看连接状态、一键探测和重启，还能直接改配置。

description.en: Memweave is a DSH organizational memory and task-evolution plugin. It decomposes goals into task networks, captures verifiable judgments and anti-patterns, and tracks iteration with measurable Loops. Features visual storage settings, category browsing, lifecycle management, and data exchange with existing plugins.
description.zh: 把目标拆成任务网络，记录可验证的判断和反模式，用可衡量的 Loop 追踪迭代，沉淀成组织记忆。

description.en: Detects available NVIDIA NIM models, verifies each with a real streaming call, saves the API key in-panel, and one-click configures DeepSeek Harness settings.
description.zh: 检测可用的 NVIDIA NIM 模型、逐个真实试调用验证、面板内保存 API Key，一键配置进 DeepSeek Harness 设置。

description.en: AI research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: papers, PDF reading, annotations, linked notes & source-grounded AI conversations. 原生 AI 科研工作台：论文管理、精读批注、并排笔记与来源引用。开发中 · Pre-release.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读论文、做批注、记笔记，还能让 AI 基于原文回答问题。

description.en: Query Bilibili public data from a DeepSeek Harness agent — account stats, upload lists, video stats, and user search.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查询 B 站公开数据：账号粉丝、投稿列表、单视频互动数据与用户搜索。

description.en: 让 AI 像人一样操控 Windows：鼠标一步一步挪、按键按下抬起、拖拽、逐字打字，完了还能截图看一眼结果。  Human-like mouse and keyboard control for Windows: eased cursor movement, press/release, drag, per-character typing, plus screenshots to verify the result.
description.zh: 让 AI 像人一样操控 Windows 鼠标键盘，一步步移动、点击、拖拽、逐字打字，还能截图验证结果。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：多段引用卡片 + 引用回复，让引用不再是一坨 > 文本 | DSH web plugin: multi-quote cards for quoting and replying
description.zh: 把聊天里的引用变成多段卡片，还能直接引用回复，告别一坨 > 文本

description.en: 工业电子风 DeepSeek Harness 皮肤：全直角、深蓝工作区、白字、鲸鱼字标、五套低饱和配色、可调壁纸与毛玻璃。Industrial-electronics skin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上工业电子风皮肤，全直角深蓝界面，五套低饱和配色，壁纸和毛玻璃都能调。

description.en: Keep every conversation fluid.
description.zh: 把会话记录存进 SQLite，翻页更快、占用更小，还能随时回看历史对话。

description.en: Stage several selected excerpts in a draft composer, then ask in a read-only temporary side chat: only read, glob, grep and read_image are allowed, with its own model and reasoning effort; closing the tab archives the session.
description.zh: 把多次选中的文字攒进草稿区（计数、悬停预览、一键清除），再在只读的临时侧边聊天里追问：只放行 read/glob/grep/read_image，可单独选择模型与推理强度，关闭标签即归档。

description.en: dsh侧边栏字体、样式修改插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端侧栏和对话区调字体、字号、行距，还能把侧栏排成图标列加会话列两栏。

description.en: SSH workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage servers, keys, passwords and agents, and run remote commands from the agent.
description.zh: 在侧栏管理 SSH 服务器和凭据，让 Agent 直接连上远端执行命令，密码密钥只留在本机。

description.en: Personal local-first content studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness — manage Obsidian/Markdown drafts, approved reserves, media assets, multi-style AI rewriting, and X thread splitting.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian/Markdown 草稿、储备和配图聚成一个工作台，还能 AI 改稿、去 AI 味、拆 X 串推。

description.en: A T3 Code-style task sidebar for DeepSeek Harness, with session grouping and snooze (preview).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个 T3 Code 风格的任务侧边栏，按任务状态、工作区分组管理会话，还能把会话暂时搁置。

description.en: A traditional Chinese medicine preset for DeepSeek Harness that explains pattern identification in seven plain-language sections, recommends acupoints, flags contraindications and safety warnings, and gives only reasoning rather than doses or prescriptions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的中医经方预设（学习版）：先用一句大白话下结论，再按七段讲辨证定位、治法、方名与加减方向，推荐穴位，标出配伍禁忌、药量警示与就医提示；只讲思路，不给剂量，不出处方笺。

description.en: Everyday usability upgrades - workspace icons, AI model logos, unread reminders, profile styling, cleaner sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上工作区图标、模型 Logo、未读提醒和侧边栏美化，日常用起来更顺手。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 翻译插件：本地 Ollama 模型，任意应用划译 + 文件/PDF 双语排版，全离线
description.zh: 用本地 Ollama 模型做翻译，划词、整份文件和 PDF 都能双语对照，全程离线不出本机。

description.en: DSH 插件：左侧栏「任务时间线」面板，把每个 turn 的交付物、台账与文件变更排成一条可回溯的时间轴。零依赖、零 token。
description.zh: 左侧栏任务时间线面板，把每个 turn 的交付物、台账和文件变更排成可回溯的时间轴，点一下就能预览。

description.en: 基于 @xueray/dsh-web-bridge 0.4.5 的修改版：网页对话输入框支持粘贴与拖放附件。非官方 fork，PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0。上游 PR: https://github.com/SaiSenBox/dsh-web-bridge/pull/1
description.zh: 把网页端 DeepSeek 对话连同历史消息和附件直接拖进工作区，接着聊不用再复制粘贴。

description.en: Gates and a ledger for coding agents: denies writes to source files that were not read in this session, or that changed after they were read; records every write and verification with the real exit code; keeps the tests that failed before a fix visible until that same set passes; and flags source files changed by shell commands that were never declared. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给编程 agent 的闸门与台账：没读过的源码文件拒绝写入，读过之后又被改动的也拒绝；每次写入与验证都记下真实退出码；修之前红着的那批测试，在它们真正变绿之前会一直显示出来；脚本改了源码却没申报会一直记在台账里。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Switch between DeepSeek Harness work mode and the official chat-demo UI, with local history and ZIP import.
description.zh: 在 Harness 侧边栏一键切换工作模式和官方 chat-demo 对话界面，支持本地历史与 ZIP 导入。

description.en: 把dsh桌面端侧边栏的工作区归入自定义分类。 每个分类是一个圆角矩形框，里面放着归入它的工作区和各自的会话； 长按标题即可拖动归类与排序，便于管理对话
description.zh: 把桌面端侧边栏的工作区按自定义分类归拢，长按标题就能拖动排序，对话管理更清爽。

description.en: 知行：a local-first workday workspace for DeepSeek Harness (today, reports, goals, settings, plus 今天吃什么 / 今日运势)
description.zh: 在本地记录每天的工作与待办，自动生成日报周报、跟踪目标进度，还能查今天吃什么和今日运势。

description.en: 搞定产品设计包 · VibeCoding 项目工作台（DSH 插件）
description.zh: 在侧边栏管理 VibeCoding 项目，三步向导生成调研分析和产品五件套模板，关键动作派发到独立工作区完成。

description.en: DSH 插件：让 AI 该问的时候问、该确认的时候确认 —— 不再用「任务完成」打发你，动手前也会先把理解说清楚；回答还能直接贴图，贴文件，用指令
description.zh: 让 AI 该问就问、该确认就确认，动手前先说清理解，还能贴图贴文件用指令。

description.en: Local Personal Memory — sanitized Windows x64 sharing preview
description.zh: 把 AI 助手用过的上下文存在本地，下次自动检索，不用重复解释。

description.en: Gemini through the official Antigravity ACP server, with tools executed locally over a reverse tunnel. The default model is Gemini 3.8 Flash, and a route can use any model id that agy accepts.
description.zh: 通过官方 Antigravity ACP 接入 Gemini，工具经反向隧道在本机执行。默认模型是 Gemini 3.8 Flash，路线可以改成 agy 接受的其他模型 id。

description.en: Windows screen-region picker for the composer: drag a box over any application, fine-tune it with eight handles, then confirm or copy it, and the crop appears in the input box as an attachment ready to send with a question.
description.zh: Windows 端的圈选截图：在任意界面上拖框，用八个把手微调，确认或复制后图片直接进入输入框附件，补一句问题即可发送。

description.en: Pure Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: sends only user and assistant messages — no system prompt, no tools, no runtime context, no injected messages.
description.zh: 让 DSH 只发用户和助手消息，去掉系统提示、工具和运行时上下文，对话更干净。

description.en: Adds a Thinking language picker to Settings → General and injects a rule so the agent reasons in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese or English: the rule is written in the selected language and reminded once per turn. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer; those three languages only.
description.zh: 在设置 → 通用中新增「思考语言」选择器，并注入规则让智能体用简体中文、繁體中文或英文思考：规则用所选语言书写，每轮提醒一次。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新版本；只支持这三种语言。

description.en: Browse local AI agent projects in one DeepSeek Harness panel: filter and pin projects, pick memories, skills, and recent sessions, then continue in the original directory with an editable DSH handoff draft or export it as Markdown.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中浏览本机其他 AI Agent 的项目：筛选置顶、勾选记忆与 Skills、带上近期会话，然后在原工作目录用可编辑的交接草稿继续开发，或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: Blocks tool calls that create temporary files or directories in the workspace root, moves new root-level temp entries into tmp/_quarantine at turn end, and provides a graphical settings page.
description.zh: 拦截在仓库根目录创建临时文件或目录的工具调用，在回合结束时把新增的根目录临时项移入 tmp/_quarantine，并提供图形化设置页。

description.en: Delegate subtasks from DeepSeek Harness to Herdr-managed coding agents, harvest exact results, and review them in DSH.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的子任务派给 Herdr 管理的编码代理，拿回准确结果并在 DSH 里直接审阅。

description.en: Paste a subscription link and go: the plugin ships an embedded mihomo core, starts the proxy and routes DSH outbound traffic (including web_fetch) through it, so no separate Clash client is needed. Supports Clash / V2Ray / Shadowrocket / sing-box / Surge subscriptions. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 粘贴订阅链接即用：插件自带 mihomo 内核，自动起代理并把 DSH 出站（含 web_fetch）接管过去，不用再单独开 Clash。支持 Clash / V2Ray / Shadowrocket / sing-box / Surge 订阅。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Bilibili course study buddy for DeepSeek Harness. Four tools: study_frame grabs a timestamped frame at 1080p with region cropping and a disk cache; study_scan samples a time range into one grid image for locating; study_subs extracts AI subtitles and scores three signals to detect contaminated subtitle tracks; study_asr transcribes a short window with surrounding context. Read-only; all data stays local.
description.zh: B 站网课伴学：四个工具。study_frame 按时间点抽 1080P 帧，支持局部裁剪与磁盘缓存；study_scan 把一段区间抽成一张网格图用于定位；study_subs 取 AI 字幕并用覆盖度、术语命中、语速三个信号判定是否串台；study_asr 带上下文地局部转写。全程只读，数据留在本机。

description.en: Schedule a message you are writing in the DSH composer — text, images and files — to be sent later; the Host delivers it after the tab closes, and a message that came due while DSH was closed is sent at the next start and marked late. Tick Repeat to create a DSH Automation task instead. A peak-price hint appears when a DeepSeek model is selected and the chosen time falls in its weekday peak window.
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框里正在写的消息（文本、图片、文件）设定发送时间，由 Host 投递，关掉标签页也会发；DSH 关闭期间到点的消息会在下次启动时发送并标记为延迟。勾选重复则改为创建 DSH Automation 任务。选用 DeepSeek 模型、且所选时间落在其工作日高峰时段时，会多一行橙色价格提示。

description.en: Chinese display layer for DSH skills: the / menu groups skills under Chinese categories with Chinese names and summaries, while the invocation token stays the English /name and no SKILL.md is edited. Also fills missing summaries from install sources and moves uninstalled personal skills to a recycle bin.
description.zh: 给 DSH 技能加中文显示层：`/` 菜单按中文分类显示中文名与简介，调用仍是英文 `/name`，不改任何 SKILL.md。还能从安装来源补简介，卸载个人技能时移入回收站。

description.en: Adds a plan-then-execute loop to DSH: /autopilot-on runs grill rounds and writes brief, plan and checklist files, /autopilot-run works the checklist item by item, and after a product-code edit the plugin intercepts the turn boundary and steers the agent through rotating self-review rounds before advancing.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上「先规划再执行」的闭环：/autopilot-on 通过追问轮次产出 brief、plan、checklist 三个文件，/autopilot-run 按清单逐项执行；产品代码被修改后拦截回合边界，用 steer 让 agent 轮换多个自审视角再推进。

description.en: Connect Notion's official MCP server to DeepSeek Harness for workspace tools and resources.
description.zh: 通过 Notion 官方 MCP 将工作区工具和资源接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Pomodoro focus timer docked under the composer with long-break cycles, daily focus tracking, phase-change signals, and agent tools that read and control the timer. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 停靠在输入框下方的番茄钟，支持长休息循环、每日专注统计、阶段切换提醒，以及供 Agent 读取和控制计时器的工具。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Phone console for DeepSeek Harness over the LAN: clock, weather, notifications, sessions, balance and media control, with token pairing, a QR code and optional HTTPS.
description.zh: 把局域网里的手机变成 DSH 的触屏控制台：时钟、天气、通知、会话、余额与媒体控制，支持令牌配对、扫码连接和可选 HTTPS。

description.en: SHA-256 manifests for delivered files: build once, verify anywhere, and say exactly which bytes moved instead of 'looks fine'. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 交付文件的 SHA-256 清单：一次构建、随处校验，说清哪些字节真的动过，而不是「看起来没问题」。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Shape check for delivered documents: no title, more than one level-1 heading, a lost heading level, no conclusion up front, and nothing a reader can run to reproduce the result. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 交付文档的结构检查：没有标题、多个一级标题、标题跳级、开头没有结论、没有任何读者能跑的复现命令。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Contract structure checks for Chinese agreements: parties, date, amount consistency (uppercase vs digits), signature blocks, dispute resolution, breach clauses. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 中文合同的结构检查：甲乙方、日期、金额大小写一致、签署栏、争议解决、违约责任。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Multi-node DSH monitor and control hub: per-node status and read-only sessions, zero-config LAN networking via UDP discovery, one-click/embedded access to a real DSH UI, cross-network remote hub via outbound push, serverless invite links/IPv6, and opt-in plugin toggle/restart behind dry-run, confirmation and a JSONL audit log. By default it listens on :: / 0.0.0.0 for LAN discovery, with token-protected status and control routes; its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 多 DSH 节点监控与集中管控：逐节点状态与只读会话、UDP 发现零配置组网、一键/内嵌打开真实 DSH、跨网反向接入的远程主节点、无服务器接入码/IPv6，以及默认关闭的插件启停/重启（干跑、二次确认、JSONL 审计）。默认监听 :: / 0.0.0.0 用于局域网发现，状态与控制路由由令牌保护；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Floating music controls that only show QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, and Spotify when they publish Windows system media sessions. Windows only.
description.zh: 悬浮音乐控制卡片，只显示向系统发布媒体会话的 QQ音乐、网易云音乐和 Spotify。仅限 Windows。

description.en: Keeps the running plan when a mid-turn message arrives — open todos are written to disk, the interjection is laid out next to them in the turn it lands (cancel, amend, or separate work), a suspended-work block follows in later turns until the items are finished or cancelled, and a turn-closing guard makes leftover work explicit instead of silently dropped; it softens the attention drift rather than removing it.
description.zh: 中途插话时把计划保住：未完成的 todo 落盘，插话落地的当回合就把「被挂起的项 + 插话原文 + 取消 / 补充 / 另起一件事」摆到模型面前，之后以「挂起工作」段继续渲染，直到完成或取消；回合收尾再兜底催一次，让剩余工作被明确交代，而不是被静默丢掉——它缓解注意力漂移，但不消除。

description.en: Citation lint for delivered reports: numbering gaps, duplicate sources, sources that are listed but never cited, and local links that do not exist. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 交付报告的引用检查：编号断号、同一来源重复、列了却没被引用的来源——全部从 markdown 直接判定。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Connects one CLIProxyAPI gateway to DeepSeek Harness, speaks OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages or Google Generative AI natively, and imports the gateway model catalog into a settings page where each model can be selected.
description.zh: 把一个 CLIProxyAPI 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness，原生支持 OpenAI Responses、Chat Completions、Anthropic Messages 和 Google Generative AI 四种协议，并把网关的模型目录导入设置页，逐个选择启用哪些模型。

description.en: Derived self-check for changed files: parses PowerShell, JavaScript and JSON with the matching tool, runs the tests that own each changed plugin or project, and fails a plugin source change that ships no tests. Unrecognized extensions are recorded as skipped instead of silently passed.
description.zh: 按「本次改了什么」自动推导检查：用对应工具解析 PowerShell、JavaScript 和 JSON，运行改动文件所属插件或项目的测试，插件源码有改动却没有任何测试时直接判失败；不认识的扩展名记为跳过而不是静默通过。

description.en: Colored tags for sessions, shown on the sidebar row and in the conversation header, with preset colors, pin-to-sidebar, hover-remove and drag-to-reorder; tags persist in a Host-side storage domain and survive restarts.
description.zh: 会话彩色标签：侧边栏行与会话标题旁均可显示，提供预设颜色、固定到侧边栏、悬停移除与拖拽排序；标签存于宿主侧存储域，重启后保留。
